evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: MoH chemistry and P63/mmc superconductivity are known. Dated 2026-10-07 B1/FCC MoH searches found phase/structure predictions and FCC gamma phase prior, but no experimental superconducting exact B1 source state. The object is an ordered B1 source-phase and matched metal substitution hypothesis new to the reviewed catalogue, not first discovery of MoH or inherited NiAs Tc.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: The known competing MoH phase is hexagonal NiAs/P63mmc, with high-pressure synthesis and ambient recovered measurements; known superconductivity in that phase is not this B1 source phase. FCC gamma MoH exists as a pressure/temperature phase prior, while source B1 is locally stable at Gamma and sampled path. H loss, competing hcp/metal+H2, anharmonicity and the omitted magnetic competition of Cr/Mn controls are substantive falsifiers. The source paper reports a near-hull B1 phase in a separate calculation, not an exact-state thermodynamic certificate. PdH is a retained higher-lambda control and experimental benchmark, not omitted.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=-0.319 GPa, full max stress=0.319 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

counterevidence.scope: This frozen alternative has both higher coupling and higher source-model Tc than the target; the selected-control advantage does not extend to every alternative.

unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Mo replaces Cr in the same rock-salt metal/H site motif; source cell volume rises 31.870%, Mo-H versus Cr-H rises 0.180451 A and the metal self-neighbor distance rises 0.255196 A. Direct lambda is 21.448–41.624% larger at all ten sigma values and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 15.560 to 17.312 K. This bounded configured-scalar coupled metal/network contrast does not prove real magnetic CrH is a weaker superconductor.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare B1 MoH with the same-composition NiAs competitor and an H-loss reaction at a common functional, while separately testing magnetic CrH/MnH and common sampling for the source paired response. Retained B1 local stability and coupling gain support the bounded source hypothesis; easy phase conversion, H loss or magnetic/method reversal opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
